title: Ad Tracking & Targeted Advertising Policy Template
metaDescription: Create a comprehensive policy on ad tracking and targeted advertising. Protect user privacy with our customizable template for websites and apps.
description: A comprehensive policy template that helps websites and applications clearly disclose their ad tracking practices, targeted advertising methods, and user opt-out options to ensure transparency and compliance with privacy regulations.

sections.heading: Introduction and Scope
sections.content: This Ad Tracking and Targeted Advertising Policy explains how {{COMPANY_NAME}} collects, uses, and shares information for advertising purposes on {{WEBSITE_URL}}. This policy covers behavioral advertising, personalized ads, cross-site tracking, and retargeting practices. We are committed to transparency about our advertising practices and your choices regarding targeted advertising.

sections.heading: Types of Ad Tracking We Use
sections.content: We may use the following tracking technologies for advertising: (1) Cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences and track browsing behavior, (2) Device fingerprinting to create unique identifiers based on device characteristics, (3) Pixel tags and web beacons to measure ad effectiveness, (4) Cross-site tracking to follow your activity across multiple websites, and (5) {{ADDITIONAL_TRACKING}} as needed for our advertising services.

sections.heading: Information We Collect for Advertising
sections.content: For targeted advertising, we may collect: browsing history and pages visited, search terms and keywords, device information (type, operating system, browser), geographic location data, demographic information where available, purchase history and preferences, and interaction data with our ads and content. We may also receive information from advertising partners and data brokers to enhance ad targeting.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information for Ads
sections.content: We use collected information to: display personalized advertisements based on your interests, measure ad performance and effectiveness, conduct A/B testing for ad optimization, create audience segments for targeted campaigns, prevent ad fraud and ensure security, and provide relevant product recommendations. We may share anonymized data with {{AD_PARTNERS}} for these purposes.

placeholders.label: Advertising Partners
placeholders.defaultValue: Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and other advertising networks

sections.heading: Third-Party Advertising Partners
sections.content: We work with third-party advertising networks including {{PARTNER_LIST}} who may collect information about your visits to our site and other websites to provide targeted advertisements. These partners may use cookies, web beacons, and other tracking technologies. Each partner has their own privacy policy governing their data collection and use practices.

placeholders.label: List of Ad Partners
placeholders.defaultValue: Google AdSense, Facebook Audience Network, Amazon Associates

sections.heading: Your Opt-Out Rights and Choices
sections.content: You can control targeted advertising through: (1) Browser settings to block or delete cookies, (2) Industry opt-out tools like NAI Consumer Opt-Out or DAA WebChoices, (3) Platform-specific controls (Google Ad Settings, Facebook Ad Preferences), (4) Mobile advertising ID controls on iOS and Android, (5) Using privacy-focused browsers like a privacy-focused browser that block tracking by default. Contact us at {{CONTACT_EMAIL}} for assistance with opt-out procedures.

sections.heading: Data Retention and Updates
sections.content: We retain advertising data for {{RETENTION_PERIOD}} or as required by law. We may update this policy to reflect changes in our advertising practices or legal requirements. Material changes will be communicated through {{NOTIFICATION_METHOD}}. Your continued use of our services after policy updates constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

useCases: E-commerce websites that use retargeting ads to show products to previous visitors
Content publishers displaying behavioral advertising based on reader interests
Mobile apps that collect data for personalized in-app advertising
SaaS companies using tracking pixels to measure marketing campaign effectiveness
Online services required to comply with GDPR, CCPA, or other privacy regulations
